name: OSS_SUBSCRIPTION_INTERACTIONS
description: This table is used to store the subscription interactions.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Column used to capture Interaction Id

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Column to store the subscription id to which interaction belongs to

columns.name: MESSAGE_SENT_STATUS
columns.description: Email message sent status returned by the ATK API when we call the ATK API to send email

columns.name: MESSAGE_SENT_DETAILS
columns.description: Email message sent details returned by the ATK API when we call the ATK API to send email

columns.name: MESSAGE_SENT_ID
columns.description: Email message sent ID returned by the ATK API when we call the ATK API to send email.

columns.name: MESSAGE_GATEWAY_ID
columns.description: Email message gaateway ID returned by the ATK API when we call the ATK API to send email.

columns.name: INTERACTION_TO
columns.description: Column to store the email ids to the interaction is sent

columns.name: INTERACTION_FROM
columns.description: Column to store the emails from whom the interaction is sent

columns.name: INTERACTION_CC
columns.description: Column to store the emails which are cced to whom the interaction is sent

columns.name: INTERACTION_REPLY_TO
columns.description: Column to store the emails which need to be replied

columns.name: MESSAGE_SUBJECT
columns.description: Column to store the email subject

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Column is used to store the email text

columns.name: EVENT_CODE
columns.description: Column to store the subscription Event Code

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Column to store the message template

columns.name: LAYOUT_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Column to store the subscription layout template

columns.name: TERMS_LAYOUT_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Column to store terms layout template

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_CHANNEL
columns.description: Column to store the communication channel to which interaction belongs to

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
